title: dryopteris simasakii
intro: Dryopteris simasakii, commonly known as the Thai royal fern, is a species of plant in the Dryopteris genus. It is a type of fern, a vascular plant that reproduces via spores rather than seeds. The health benefits of Dryopteris simasakii include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve immune function due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
